blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Philippines — Ayala Foundation and the LH Paragon Group through its philanthropic arm, LH Foundation, Inc. (LHFI), have entered a partnership to support at least 100 young Filipino women pursuing college education through the U-GO Scholar Grant Program, with LH Foundation committing ₱20 million in scholarship funding, with a peso-for-peso match from U-GO Global to strengthen support for the scholars. Formalized through a Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) signed at the Oakridge Executive Club in Mandaue City, the partnership will provide financial assistance to scholars from School Year 2026–2027 through 2029-2030, helping them continue their studies and complete their college […]...
